biography.intro: Dr. Riji Rasheed is a homeopathic physician practising in Kattakkada, Thiruvananthapuram, with a clinical focus on hair and scalp disorders alongside general homeopathic practice.
paragraphs: I am Dr. Riji Rasheed, a Homoeopathic physician with over 16 years of clinical experience. During my years of practice at Dr Rijis Health Care, Kattakada, I observed that hair loss was not merely a cosmetic concern—it often reflected deeper disturbances within the body and mind.

Patients suffering from alopecia, androgenetic hair loss, dandruff-related hair fall, post-COVID hair loss, thyroid disorders, PCOS, stress, anxiety, and nutritional deficiencies inspired me to study hair disorders more deeply. Every successful recovery reinforced my belief that lasting hair restoration requires identifying and treating the root cause rather than masking symptoms.

Over the years, I have managed thousands of hair-related cases, refining a patient-centered approach that combines detailed case-taking, constitutional homoeopathic prescribing, lifestyle guidance, and long-term follow-up. My special interest lies in helping patients regain not only healthy hair but also confidence and emotional well-being.

Today, hair restoration has become one of the core specialties of Dr Rijis Health Care, driven by a commitment to scientific clinical observation, individualized homoeopathic treatment, and compassionate patient care. My mission is to help people restore their hair naturally by addressing the underlying causes and promoting holistic healing.
"Healthy hair begins with a healthy person. Treat the cause, and nature restores the rest."

mission.mission: To treat the person rather than the complaint — identifying why hair or skin is behaving as it is, and being honest about what treatment can and cannot achieve.
mission.vision: To make careful, unhurried homeopathic care accessible to patients wherever they are, and to raise the standard of what people expect from a hair consultation.

values.title: Honesty about outcomes
values.detail: Patients are told at the first consultation what is realistically achievable in their case — including when the answer is limited. No guaranteed results, no fixed-outcome packages.

values.title: Investigate before prescribing
values.detail: Where the history points to a thyroid, iron or hormonal cause, testing comes before treatment. Treating the scalp alone rarely holds.

values.title: Alongside, not instead of
values.detail: Homeopathic treatment complements conventional care. No patient is ever advised to stop a medication prescribed by another physician.

values.title: Time in the consultation
values.detail: A first consultation runs to roughly forty-five minutes because the history is where the diagnosis usually is.
